findings.title: Canonical onboarding starts too late
findings.evidence: README labels an advanced totals/report sample as hello.kujo, while the actual smallest runnable example prints Kujo Kujo. The examples README foregrounds complete interactive apps before the learning path.
findings.human_impact: Beginners hit multiple concepts before confirming the language runs.
findings.agent_impact: Agents spend tokens reconciling README quick start, actual example files, and examples index ordering.
findings.token_efficiency_impact: High for onboarding because the first copied pattern is larger than necessary.
findings.recommended_fix: Make README first code block a true minimal program and move the richer example later.

findings.title: Example trust debt is explicit and large
findings.evidence: tests/docs_examples.rs tracks 29 expected-fail examples and runs only five examples end-to-end.
findings.human_impact: Users can land on examples that are known stale or parser-incompatible.
findings.agent_impact: Stale examples become false repo-local training context.
findings.token_efficiency_impact: High because agents must inspect tests to identify canonical examples.
findings.recommended_fix: Rank expected-fail examples by visibility, repair top-tier files, and label or quarantine the rest.

findings.title: README validation commands are not currently all green
findings.evidence: cargo run -- test --runtime vm and cargo run -- test --runtime dual both exited 3, passing 141/144 fixtures and failing test_higher_order, bytecode_vm, and stdlib_test.
findings.agent_impact: Agents may chase unrelated fixture drift during normal work.
findings.token_efficiency_impact: Medium to high because failure logs are long.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix fixture drift or temporarily document known failing fixtures.

findings.title: LSP CLI output mapping repeats the same shape
findings.evidence: LSP helper commands repeat JSON mapping and plain row printing inline while cli_output.rs already has small emission helpers.
findings.human_impact: Intent is hidden by serialization mechanics.
findings.agent_impact: Agents can update one output mode and miss another.
findings.recommended_fix: Add tiny typed helpers for JSON rows, optional records, and tab-delimited rows; migrate one command at a time.

findings.title: SSG benchmark output is long and manual
findings.evidence: Commands::BenchSsg mixes validation, execution, aggregation, and many manual println report lines.
findings.human_impact: The command handler is hard to scan.
findings.agent_impact: Agents must keep output contract details in context while editing benchmark logic.
findings.recommended_fix: Move report formatting into a dedicated SSG renderer with snapshots.

findings.title: Output style guidance and examples are inconsistent
findings.evidence: The cookbook recommends section/kv helpers for output, but many multi-section examples still use repeated print banners.
findings.human_impact: Style guidance and copied examples conflict.
findings.recommended_fix: Refactor a small canonical example set to helper style while keeping tiny scripts direct.

findings.title: Core source files are large and high-context
findings.evidence: Line counts include src/vm.rs at 9710, src/jit.rs at 9311, src/interpreter/mod.rs at 6281, src/interpreter/native_functions/mod.rs at 6192, and src/main.rs at 3073.
findings.human_impact: Localized changes require more scrolling and context management.
findings.agent_impact: Large files are expensive to read and patch safely.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract only stable, tested seams such as output rendering before considering runtime internals.

findings.title: Runtime diagnostic help is uneven
findings.evidence: Diagnostic rendering and JSON shape are clean, but several runtime diagnostic goldens still have null help for common failures.
findings.human_impact: Common runtime failures do not always tell users the next action.
findings.agent_impact: Actionable help reduces retry and search loops.
findings.recommended_fix: Add targeted help for undefined identifier, non-callable call, missing module, capability denial, and invalid operations.

findings.title: No single agent-first repo entrypoint
findings.evidence: README links many references and .github agent instructions exist, but no root AGENTS.md or docs/agent-onboarding.md identifies canonical examples and safe validation paths.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a concise agent onboarding document.
validation: cargo test --test readme_contracts if README links change

findings.title: Generated reports are noisy for first-read context
findings.evidence: Generated inventories and scripts are useful but broad searches surface repeated rows and generated markdown before core language files.
findings.agent_impact: Agents may mistake generated rows for canonical source.
findings.recommended_fix: Document generated-path search exclusions in the agent onboarding guide.
